meta.title: Pull request lifecycle
meta.description: The states a pull request moves through, from draft to merged, with review rounds, a merge queue and the way back when checks fail.

summary.headline: A pull request merges only after an approval on its latest commits and green checks on top of the current main branch.
points: Drafts run CI but ask no one to review.
Review comments loop on In review; requested changes go round until fixes are pushed.
New commits after approval dismiss it and send the pull request back to review.
The merge queue rebuilds on the latest main, so a red build there sends it back for changes.

facts.States: 7 plus a check, start and end

data.title: Start
data.description: The author pushes a branch and opens a pull request.

data.title: Draft
data.subtitle: Work in progress
data.description: CI runs on every push, but no reviewers are requested.

data.title: Ready for review
data.subtitle: Reviewers requested
data.description: CODEOWNERS adds the owning team; a reviewer is assigned by round robin.

data.title: In merge queue
data.subtitle: Waiting for its turn
data.description: The queue tests each pull request on top of main plus the ones ahead of it.

data.title: Checks pass on latest main?
data.description: Unit, integration and contract tests, plus the security scan.

data.title: Merged
data.subtitle: Squashed into main
data.description: The squash commit triggers the deploy to staging.

steps.title: Overview
steps.description: The main road runs from Draft to Merged. The back-arrows are the review rounds, and the rose states are where the pull request waits on its author.

steps.title: From draft to review
steps.description: The author opens a draft while the work is unfinished. Marking it ready requests the code owners, and the state moves on when a reviewer starts.

steps.title: Review rounds
steps.description: Comments keep the pull request In review (the loop). Requesting changes hands it back to the author; pushing fixes brings it back for another look.

steps.title: Approval
steps.description: A code owner approves. If the author pushes new commits afterwards, the approval is dismissed and the pull request goes back to review.

steps.title: Merge queue
steps.description: Approved pull requests join the merge queue, which builds each one on the latest main. Green merges; red sends it back to the author as Changes requested.

steps.title: Closing without merging
steps.description: A pull request that is no longer wanted is closed. It can be reopened while the branch exists; once the branch is deleted it is done.
